definitions.gloss: unreservedly; openly; without holding back (手放しで)
definitions.explanation: Showing joy or praise openly and without any reservation. Almost always used adverbially with で before a verb.

definitions.gloss: no hands; letting go of the handlebars or wheel
definitions.explanation: Literally, without holding on with one's hands, as when riding a bicycle with no hands.

examples.japanese: {手放|てばな}し⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}ぶ→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
{手放|てばな}し⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{褒|ほ}める→褒める：01204_homeru⟧わけ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧はいかない。
examples.english: I can't praise it without reservation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手放|てばな}し⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歓迎|かんげい}する→歓迎する：26997_kangeisuru⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: Few people welcome the new policy without reservation.

examples.japanese: {手放|てばな}し⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危|あぶ}ない→危ない：00768_abunai⟧。
examples.english: Riding with no hands is dangerous.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手放|てばな}し⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: To ride a bicycle with no hands.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→頃：32850_koro⟧、⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手放|てばな}し⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{転|ころ}んだ→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧⟦ことがある→ことがある：32886_kotogaaru⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I fell off my bicycle riding with no hands.

notes:
Sense 1 is often used in the negative: {手放|てばな}し⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}べない→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧ (one can't be entirely happy about it).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手放|てばな}し⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}ぶ→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧: to rejoice wholeheartedly
- {手放|てばな}し⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{褒|ほ}める→褒める：01204_homeru⟧ / ⟦{絶賛|ぜっさん}→絶賛：13840_zessan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to praise unreservedly
- {手放|てばな}し⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧: riding or driving with no hands

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手放|てばな}す→手放す：05338_tebanasu⟧: verb, to let go of, to part with
